description: Two pairs of loaded sources that collide under CLDR canonicalization without sharing a written primary language code: mo/ro and cmn/zh. DefaultStrings requires tiebreakers keyed by the CANONICAL language code here (ro:[mo, ro], zh:[cmn, zh]). VERIFIED by building it without them, which fails with: You must specify tiebreaker locales via 'tiebreakerLocalesByLanguageCode' to resolve ambiguity for language code 'ro' because localized strings exist for the following locale[s]: [mo, ro]. This is the configuration in which the whole-list solver and the single-locale kernel actually select different locales for the same request.
